newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AVGOLD, GENCOR SCRAP GOLD MERGER.
newsitem.headline: AVGOLD, GENCOR SCRAP GOLD MERGER.

text.p: Avgold Ltd said on Tuesday that it and Gencor Ltd had decided not to proceed with the planned merger of their South African gold mining operations, Fairview and Eastern Transvaal Consolidated (ETC).
Avgold blamed the decision on the slump in the gold price, which earlier this month hit a 12-year low.
"Based on the revised valuations, Gencor and Avgold have decided not to proceed with the merger," the company said in a statement.
The planned merger would have seen the combined operations owned 55 percent by Avgold and 45 percent by Gencor, with Gencor contributing some 180 million rand in cash to fund capital spending.

ETC will now continue to operate on a stand-alone basis. The company said it planned to erect a biological oxidation plant to replace the roaster plant at New Consort and invest in the infrastucture necessary to mine deeper ore reserves.
ETC is considering various options which would do away with the need for a new shaft to access the deeper ore reserves at Sheba.
